# 🎧 Melofy Support Guide

Thank you for being part of the **Melofy** community! Whether you are having audio playback hiccups, build problems on Tauri/Capacitor, or just want to request a cool new glassmorphic feature, we're here to help.

Before opening a new issue, please consult the support paths outlined below.

---

## 🗺️ How to Get Help

### 1️⃣ Check the Documentation First
Many common environment variables, setup commands, and configuration queries for the monorepo are covered in:
* **[The Main Melofy README](file:///c:/Codes/projects/melofy/README.md)**: Setup, architectural breakdown, and quick launch instructions.
* **`NodeLink/`**: Specific guidance for setting up your NodeLink server and linking it with Spotify/Upstash.
* **`apps/desktop`**: Troubleshooting guidelines regarding Tauri v2 build parameters.

### 2️⃣ Join the Discord Server (Fastest Support)
We have a vibrant hub where Melofy developers and supporters hang out. You can ask questions, discuss custom builds, and get immediate feedback:
* **Lazy Devs Discord Server**: [Join the Discord Community](https://discord.gg/ZVCB8EnRX2)
* Select the relevant channel (e.g. `#melofy-support`, `#bugs-report`, or `#general-chat`).

### 3️⃣ GitHub Issues (Bugs & Feature Requests)
If you've confirmed that you are encountering a bug or have a clear suggestion:
* **Search Existing Issues**: Look through our [Issues Tracker](https://github.com/ShreyJaiswal1/melofy/issues) to see if someone else has run into the same scenario.
* **Create a New Issue**: If it is a new bug, choose the appropriate issue template (Bug Report or Feature Request) and fill in the details.

---

## 🗂️ Support Categories

Refer to this chart to decide where to ask your questions:

| Issue Type | Recommended Channel | Details |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **NodeLink Server Crashes** | Discord (`#melofy-support`) or GitHub Issues | For streaming source issues, Spotify API token retrieval, or buffer delays. |
| **Tauri Desktop Build Errors** | Discord (`#melofy-support`) | Issues relating to Rust compilation, native webviews, or frameless border assets. |
| **Capacitor Mobile Sync** | Discord (`#melofy-support`) | Questions about Android/iOS builds, social login plugins, or system media controls. |
| **Feature Requests** | GitHub Issues | Let's design premium features together! Create a detailed proposal issue. |
| **Security Auditing** | GitHub Security Advisories | Please report security flaws privately. See our [Security Policy](SECURITY.md). |
